chunks: And other (benefits) which you have not yet obtained, are within the compass of God, for God has power over everything.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God has encompassed what we cannot?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Al-Hawaadith al-Baadiyah' (future events), illustrating that God's knowledge encompasses all potentialities and realities beyond human perception. It underscores the divine attribute of Qadir (All-Powerful) in actualizing what is hidden, reinforcing the believer's trust in God's comprehensive control over both the seen and unseen realms.
